summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Harold Homer Anderson, an American psychologist who lived from October 23, 1897 to February 9, 1990. He served as a research professor of psychology at Michigan State University. His published work spanned child psychology, clinical psychology, personality, and cross-national research.
